==Description==
The '''Reaper''' was a summoner [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. While it walked quite slowly, it had somewhat high health for its debut. It could also summon [[Scarecrow (Nightmare Carnival)|Scarecrow]]s, [[Ghost (Nightmare Carnival)|Ghosts]], [[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummies]], and [[Strong Mummy|Strong Mummies]], making it the Halloween equivalent of the [[Necromancer (Legacy Enemy)|Necromancer]].

==Appearance==
The '''Reaper''' wore a black cloak and a black hood. Its head was reflective black and was faceless. It had white cobblestone skin, grey granite legs and a chain across its torso. It also carried a scythe.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]] and [[Ranger|Outlaw]] are recommended against this [[Enemies|enemy]].
**It may be ideal for these towers to be set to ''Strongest'' to target the '''Reaper''' instead of the [[enemies]] that it spawns.
**However, this may be an issue when higher health enemies, such as [[Clown (Nightmare Carnival)|Clown]]s and [[Frankenstein (Nightmare Carnival)|Frankenstein]]s, appear.
*Splash damage towers, such as the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Demoman]], are highly recommended against the '''Reaper''' as the enemies it summons form large hordes.

==Trivia==
*The '''Reaper''' was based on the Grim Reaper, a personified character representing death.
**This was ironic as the '''Reaper''' can summon [[enemies]], although these enemies could already be considered dead.
*A similar enemy to the '''Reaper''' can be found in Hardcore mode, the [[Fallen Reaper]].
*This was the only enemy that could not be spawned by the [[Jack O' Bot]] during the [[Halloween 2019 Event]].
